# CyberAntigravity

> CyberAntigravity is an independent, 100% free cybersecurity education and digital safety platform empowering individuals, students, developers, and organizations with proactive defense literacy, threat visualization, and browser-based security utilities.

## Mission & Principles
- **Free & Open Access**: Cybersecurity education belongs to everyone. No paywalls, no mandatory tracking, and no monetized user vulnerabilities.
- **Privacy by Design**: All interactive tools run client-side via browser APIs (e.g., Web Crypto CSPRNG). Zero server transmission of sensitive inputs or credentials.
- **Visual Storytelling**: Complex threat vectors (phishing, credential stuffing, social engineering, attack surfaces) are demystified through interactive animated diagrams and scenarios.

## Core Educational Pillars & Interactive Modules
- [Home (Cyber Defense Command Center)](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/): Interactive ecosystem overview, threat landscapes, visual storytelling, and quick start paths.
- [Cyber Safety Hub](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/cyber-safety): Comprehensive everyday digital hygiene guide covering passwords, MFA, smartphone protection, endpoint hardening, red flags, and emergency response workflows.
- [Scam Awareness Learning Hub](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/scam-awareness): Deep-dives into social engineering deception, scam psychology, red flag spotters, and response strategies.
  - [Scam Types Directory](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/scam-awareness/types): Category catalog covering phishing, investment fraud, tech support scams, imposter fraud, and identity theft.
  - [Phishing Interactive Lab](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/scam-awareness/types/phishing): Hands-on email header, sender domain, and deceptive link inspection sandbox.
  - [Scam IQ Challenge](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/scam-awareness/challenge): Interactive scenario evaluations testing real-time fraud detection judgment.
- [Cyber IQ Quiz Arena](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/cyber-iq): Interactive knowledge assessment across core security categories with difficulty tiers, instant explanations, and local scoring.
- [Cybersecurity Learning Hub](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/learn): 9-level progressive learning roadmap covering computing fundamentals, network protocols, web defense, and ethical security literacy.
  - [Student Progress Dashboard](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/learn/progress): Local, privacy-first tracker for completed quizzes, skill ranks, and achievement badges.
  - [Cybersecurity Fundamentals Guide](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/learn/cybersecurity-fundamentals): Foundational guide establishing core concepts of defense and trust architecture.
- [Cybersecurity Tools Hub](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/tools): Complete directory of free browser-based digital defense utilities.
  - [Password Generator](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/tools/password-generator): Cryptographically random password and multi-word passphrase generator using Web Crypto CSPRNG.
  - [Password Strength Calculator](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/tools/password-strength): Real-time entropy bit-rating and GPU cluster crack time calculator.
  - [URL Structure Explainer](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/tools/url-explainer): Dissects URLs into protocol, host, domain, and query parameters to inspect suspicious links safely.
  - [Password Reuse Risk Checker](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/tools/password-reuse): Models credential stuffing blast radius across personal and work services.
  - [Security Headers Inspector](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/tools/security-headers): Educational visualizer explaining CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and security response headers.
  - [Cyber Hygiene Assessment](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/tools/cyber-hygiene): Multi-category digital posture audit with actionable defensive recommendations.
- [Cybersecurity Guides & Knowledge Hub](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/blog): In-depth research articles covering passkeys, phishing defense, zero trust, network security, and social engineering.
- [About CyberAntigravity](https://cyberantigravity.vercel.app/about): Platform mission, educational mandate, team principles, and researcher disclosure policies.

## Target Audience
- Students and beginners exploring cybersecurity fundamentals and defensive mindsets.
- Internet users seeking to protect personal accounts, families, and digital identities against scams.
- Developers and IT learners seeking practical guides for security headers, authentication, and secure password hygiene.
